lines.text: A lift gate. Boars push gates open... but they can't lift one.
A rock? For... vibes? Nah. Skip.
Put your big cousin on the short end, and the little kid can lift the long end.
A boar-proof garden. Tobias is gonna flip.
Being scared's normal. Building something... helps.
Don't tell Tobias I said that.

rows.text: a heavy rock on the short side balances the long gate
